requires: python3 + numpy + pillow, for the verifiers only. bundle.json and the sheets need nothing.

contents.index.html: the landing -- no JavaScript, reflows, fits any viewport, 2 clicks to any symbol
contents.index.json: the same tree, for an agent
contents.index.<lang>.html: the landing in sw, am, id, hi, tpi. Prose only — the notation needs no translation. Machine-suggested and unreviewed; untranslated strings fall back to English
contents.explore.html: the chart catalogue, navigable — no script, and every state it can show is in the file at rest
contents.explore.json: the same catalogue, for an agent
contents.SKILL.md: the method, loadable as an agent skill
contents.ul.py: one command: glyph | mark | claim | open | verify
contents.i18n/: 27 languages, covering the regions asked for. The NOTATION needs no translation -- the status is drawn, the marks are figures -- so these carry the prose, and what they still want is a word a language already has
contents.slices/: 93 sheets: one generator over every planar slice of configuration space. Ringed cells are attested operators; the rest has never been looked at
contents.charts/: 88 file(s): slices of the placement space the operators sample. The schemas are regions of it, not a vocabulary of ten
contents.find/: 188 file(s): every orbit the system permits, drawn on one sheet, plus the measured index that makes them searchable by shape
contents.s/: 504 symbol pages (L2) with a JSON twin each; 'near this' is computed from a measured axis, so the thesaurus cannot drift from the taxonomy
contents.cells/: 2 grids of cells; every cell readable as text via title, desc and data-* -- no rendering required
contents.scripts/: 1 writing-system reference page(s) -- a convenience, explicitly NOT a comparison to UL
contents.verify/images/: 3 source sheets — the evidence the grammar was measured off, so the checks run from a bare copy

integrity.sha256sums: SHA256SUMS covers every file except itself. Verify with: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
integrity.ipfs_cid: recorded in ../CID.txt, not here -- storing it inside would change the content it names
